meta.method: Rings are decoded and re-grouped into outer rings and holes. Pairwise intersections use polygon-clipping. Coverage is audited twice: a 1-degree land sample with even-odd point-in-polygon, and a polygon-level land-minus-assigned difference per 30x30-degree tile. Disputed/no-administration zones are counted separately from unassigned land.

polygon.method: 30x30-degree tiles; land minus union(polities, disputed areas) with polygon-clipping
